perfMonitor.title: PerfMonitor
perfMonitor.description: Warns when Discord stalls and shows whether plugins, themes or Discord caused it.

platformSpoofer.title: PlatformSpoofer
platformSpoofer.description: Appear as Desktop, Mobile, Web or Console. Switch from the status menu.

pooWangUploader.title: PooWangUploader
pooWangUploader.description: Send attachments through poo.wang with retention-controlled links instead of storing them on Discord.

privacyPruner.title: PrivacyPruner
privacyPruner.description: Deletes your expired messages per channel retention policy, keeping messages marked Keep.

questCompleter.title: QuestCompleter
questCompleter.description: Completes enrolled Discord quests without installing the advertised game.

steamRichPresence.title: SteamRichPresence
steamRichPresence.description: Shows the Steam game you are playing, including Proton games.

update.patch.title: Custom updater
update.patch.description: In-app updater that rebuilds this distribution and keeps your selection.

userplugin-manager.patch.title: User Plugin Manager
userplugin-manager.patch.description: Installs and updates custom plugins from Discord settings.

runtime-noise.patch.title: NoTrack hardening
runtime-noise.patch.description: Keeps analytics and Sentry off without failed sentry-ipc requests.

hide-media.patch.title: HideMedia auto-hide
hide-media.patch.description: Media is not loaded until you click it.

perf-attribution.patch.title: Performance attribution
perf-attribution.patch.description: Times plugin renders and event handlers for PerfMonitor.

webpack-fast-patching.patch.title: Fast startup patching
webpack-fast-patching.patch.description: Skips modules no plugin patches and compiles each patched module once.

crearts.title: CreArts v3 (repatched)
crearts.description: CreArts v3 fixed for current Discord. The original theme is archived upstream.
crearts.author: Daniel Klingel / CreArts-Community; fixes by DarkPhilosophy
